scale.reading: At 1.00 USD, verified merges ALONE reach 1B USD a year only at about 83 million a month: more than 90% of every pull request GitHub merges today. So the path is several lines together (merges, agent checks, bounty escrow, lab task packages) and a price that follows the measured cost and value, not one line.
